rationale: Adding deep branch/BU hierarchy later may require remapping authority/reporting history, but explicit legal-entity/project ownership already preserves recoverable anchors.
Configuration hierarchy depth can be expanded later if version/effective-binding semantics are preserved by the deterministic substrate; migration may be broad but history need not be lost.
Tasks/notifications/ball-in-court are derived operational surfaces over retained lifecycle state and can be expanded later without changing historical truth.
Search/index breadth can be added over retained canonical records and evidence without rewriting transaction history.
Broad custom fields/no-code schema can be introduced later through controlled metadata/versioning, with migration burden but no unavoidable loss if typed core records are preserved.
General workflow breadth is expensive to add later, but V1 retains durable/versioned approval primitives and configuration binding so historical approvals need not be rewritten.
Category/trade/project-eligibility depth can be expanded over retained vendor/project relationships; absence does not destroy core transaction truth.
Deep qualification/compliance lifecycle may require migration and policy backfill, but minimum eligibility state/evidence is already retained in SPINE.
Performance scoring can be calculated later from retained deterministic outcome facts; the scoring model itself is recoverable.
Capacity/exposure optimization is derived from retained vendor/project/commitment truth and can be added later.
A richer item/material catalogue can be introduced later but mapping historical freeform lines may be costly; transaction identity remains recoverable.
Reusable taxonomy can be layered later over retained package/requisition/vendor relationships, with migration burden but no unrecoverable truth loss.
Full claim/certification workflow is costly to deepen later, but valuation/progress events and posting/correction substrate preserve the commercial history required to elaborate it.
Bond/guarantee/insurance lifecycle automation can be expanded later if terms/evidence are retained; retention/advance/recoupment positions are separated into SPINE by the v0.3 amendment.
Procurement planning/milestone depth can be added over retained demand/tender states; planning is not required to reconstruct transaction truth.
Long-lead orchestration can be added later but historical milestone mapping may be costly; underlying commitment/item/evidence anchors remain available.
Bid-form configurability can expand later; canonical bid-line/comparison structure is separately retained in SPINE.
Rich clarification/addenda correspondence is costly to backfill, but exact bid/revision/evidence identity and manual evidence references preserve the core award basis.
A distinct recommendation object can be added later; governed award proposal/justification and approval evidence remain in SPINE.
Negotiation-log breadth can be expanded later using retained revisions/evidence; it is not required to preserve canonical award truth.
Document-compilation/template breadth is an output surface over retained commitment/evidence data and can be expanded later.
Detailed GRN/receipt workflow is costly to expand later, but commercial valuation/receipt evidence is retained by FIN-11 and inventory stock truth is explicitly outside V1.
Full subcontract claim workflow can be elaborated later because valuation events, positions and evidence survive; workflow detail may require migration but not historical reinvention.
Detailed final-account/closeout workflow may be costly to add later, but commitment/change/valuation history and terminal-state capability preserve the required truth.

Automated email/message-channel capture cannot reconstruct every omitted historical conversation, but V1 commercial decisions require evidence references/uploads; channel automation is therefore not a truth prerequisite.
Self-registration can be added later over the retained external identity/vendor model; invite-first operation remains valid.
External API breadth can be exposed incrementally because bounded internal actions/events are SPINE.
Migration/import breadth can be expanded later; stable IDs and validation/reconciliation contracts protect core truth.
Export/BI/accounting-handoff breadth can expand later over stable canonical records and interface contracts.
Dashboard/report UI is derived from canonical query/truth contracts and can be expanded later.
Saved views/personalization are recoverable UI preferences over stable queries.
Native payment/banking execution is a large regulated/operational addition, but external payment authority and mirrored states allow later integration without reconstructing procurement history.
Full RFI/submittal/transmittal domain is costly to add, but exact external-document references and procurement evidence preserve the seam; it is not required to reconstruct retained commercial truth.
A persistent supplier portal/dashboard can be added later over retained external identity and task actions.
Marketplace/network discovery is an additive business model over retained vendor identity/categories.
Native clients can be added over stable bounded APIs/actions without changing historical semantics.
Offline synchronization is expensive to add because conflict/idempotency rules broaden, but stable IDs/bounded actions/concurrency semantics preserve a viable later path.
Extraction can be added later because provenance/source identity is SPINE.
Copilot/recommendation can be added later over retained decision/evidence truth.
Autonomous actions can be added later because bounded actions, authority and audit are SPINE.
Inventory/warehouse can be added as a separate stock domain later; procurement retains commercial receipt/valuation events without pretending to own stock truth.
HR/payroll/attendance is independent of the procurement/commercial truth graph.
CRM/sales/client management is independent of the retained procurement/commercial truth graph.
